note: Both sets suffer from severe hallucinations, fabricating a quote that says '3%, 5%, and 6%' to support an incorrect 5% damping value for the edgewise mode. They also both include poorly truncated quotes for other damping claims. For the diagram labels, Set A invents definitions not found in the text (e.g., defining chord line as 'line connecting leading edge to trailing edge'), while Set B extracts trivial claims where the value is identical to the attribute. Both sets are equally flawed.
